chunks: And it is narrated from Durust, from Ajlan Abi Salih, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a woman performing tamattuʿ who entered Makkah and then menstruated. He said: “She performs saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah, then goes out with the people until she completes her tawaf afterward.”

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two hills of saʿy
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other hill of saʿy

ai.seo_question: What should a woman performing tamattuʿ do if she begins menstruating after entering Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a woman performing hajj al-tamattuʿ who begins menstruating after entering Makkah. She is instructed to perform saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah and then proceed with the people, while delaying her tawaf until later. The narration is significant in clarifying pilgrimage rulings related to menstruation and ritual purity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2756 - It is narrated from Durust, from Ajlan Abu Salih, who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a woman performing tamattu‘ who entered Mecca and began menstruating.
Imam (as) said: "She should perform sa‘i between Safa and Marwa, then leave with the people and complete her tawaf later when she becomes pure."
